description: The file is an Android activity class 'Login' which manages user login, including UI interactions, network requests to authenticate, and handling responses to proceed within the app.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: An Android activity class handling user login, network communication, and navigation to main app upon successful login.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the login activity, sets up UI components and click listeners.

methods.name: checkFields
methods.description: Validates if the email and password fields are not empty.

methods.name: POST_Request
methods.description: Sends a login request to the server using Volley HTTP library and handles the response.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses server response JSON for login success or failure, and navigates to main activity if successful.
